payload.artist_html: L. Xing, K. Niu, J. Mallon & T. Miyashita
payload.credit_html: A new armored dinosaur with double cheek horns from the early Late Cretaceous of southeastern China
payload.description_html: The type specimens of Datai yingliangis gen. et ap. nov. (individual lying on top: YLSNHM 01003; individual on bottom: YLSNHM 01002, holotype) prepared and reconstructed in situ. The head, cervical, and thoracic regions of the specimens were discovered and extracted from a single block.
